The '''West Gallery''' was a gently curving windowed corridor that overlooked the upper levels of [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]]. [[Tian Chyler]], along with two other Cloud City patrons, was present in the gallery when [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] ordered the evacuation of the city following the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire's]] invasion.<ref name="TESB" />
